display_long_description:
Step into the future of immersive reality with Arloopa XR, now available on Meta Quest! Bring digital worlds into your physical space with hyper-realistic 3D AR models, interactive scenes, and mixed reality experiences that blend seamlessly with your surroundings.

🦖 Explore & Play with 3D Models
Place lifelike 3D models — from wild animals like dinosaurs and sharks to futuristic robots, cars, and artwork — directly into your environment. Scale, rotate, and interact with these digital objects in real-time.

🏠 Transform Your Space
Design entire virtual scenes in your room! Combine multiple AR models to create magical, themed environments — like a digital art gallery, a fantasy forest, or even your own science lab with planets, the moon, and educational content.

🌐 Portals to Other Worlds
Step into fully immersive XR portals and travel to new dimensions — from fantasy realms to futuristic metaverses. Meet virtual humans, explore sci-fi settings, and experience new realities right from your headset.

🕶️ Mixed Reality with Passthrough Support
Thanks to Meta Quest's passthrough technology, you can experience AR in your real environment — blending digital elements into your actual room with precision and presence.
